settings.body:
Here is the thing none of those products will tell you. They all stopped at the same place. The surface of your skin. Eye bags don't live there.

Eye bags don't start at the surface. They start deeper — in the tissue where fluid builds overnight, where skin gets thinner with age, where the hollow that makes you look tired actually forms.

Creams sit on top. Serums sit on top. Even the gel patches you have already tried sit on top.

Your skin is designed to keep things out and it is very good at its job. That is not a quality problem with the products you chose. It is a physics problem. Nothing applied to the surface can cross that barrier.

That is the only reason nothing has worked. Not because you did not try hard enough. Because everything stopped at the same wall.

settings.question: How is this different from the gel eye patches I have already tried?
settings.answer:
Most eye patches are hydrogel. They sit on the surface of your skin and deliver moisture to the top layer. When you take them off, whatever they delivered evaporates or rubs off within a few hours.

CEBEAM Patches have hundreds of tiny dissolving cones that press painlessly into your skin when you apply them. The cones dissolve over several hours, carrying the ingredients beneath the surface. That is a physically different process from a gel patch sitting on top. It is not a better version of the same thing. It is a different way of delivering entirely.

settings.question: How quickly will I notice a difference in my eye bags?
settings.answer: You will likely notice something different the first morning you peel the patches off — the area feels softer or less swollen. Visible improvement in the appearance of eye bags typically shows within 1 to 2 weeks of twice-weekly use, and builds over 4 weeks. If you don't see a difference within 30 days you can request a full refund.

settings.question: Does it hurt?
settings.answer: You will feel a light tingle when you first apply the patches. That is normal — it is the cones starting to dissolve. It lasts a few seconds and then you feel nothing. Think of it as a gentle prickle rather than pain. If you have very sensitive skin you can do a small test patch first.

settings.question: Will it work on structural eye bags or just temporary morning puffiness?
settings.answer: Both. Hyaluronic acid delivered beneath the surface addresses the volume loss that creates structural hollowness. Caffeine delivered beneath the surface addresses the fluid retention that causes morning puffiness. Surface creams cannot reach either.

settings.question: How often do I use them and how long does one box last?
settings.answer: Twice a week before bed. One box contains 3 pairs of patches, which is roughly 1.5 weeks of use. Most customers order the larger bundles so they are never without them.

settings.question: What if they don't work for me?
settings.answer: You have 30 days to try them. If you don't see a visible difference in your eye bags, contact us for a full refund.

settings.question: Is it safe to use around the eye area?
settings.answer: The formula is dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic, and free of parabens, sulfates and harsh fragrances. The dissolving cones are made from hyaluronic acid and peptides, which are gentle and well tolerated by the skin around the eye. If you have very sensitive skin, do a small test patch on your inner wrist first.
